    About this home

    Create lasting memories in this corner lot gem in San Tan Ranch! It offers 4 bedrooms, a 2-car garage, and a desert front yard . Inside, you'll find new paint and carpet, tile floors , and a spacious living room perfect for relaxing. Cozy family room comes with a fireplace for those chilly nights. Whip up your favorite meals in the kitchen featuring quartz counters, a tile backsplash, built-in appliances, plenty of cabinet space, and a breakfast bar for casual dining. Main bedroom offers a private retreat with its own bathroom and walk-in closet. Outside, enjoy sunny days lounging by the refreshing pool, roasting s'mores at the firepit, or unwinding under the covered patio. Located just minutes from top-rated schools, parks, and more! This one's full of charm and ready to welcome you home!
